claim: This report is this machine only. It is not a fleet inventory and not universal discovery.
privacy: Optics stores destination and size metadata. It does not store prompts or completions.

compatibility.runtime: Node.js (fetch, undici, http/https, http2, net/tls, spawned curl/wget)
Python with vantio-agent-sdk (urllib, requests/httpx/aiohttp when installed)
compatibility.wrap: pip install vantio-agent-sdk && vantio run python agent.py
The vantio run python prefix does not intercept by itself.
Not a supported Optics wrap in P0.
Browser paths stay outside this wrap.
Observe wrap only. Phantom Engine Control is Linux you enroll — not offered on Windows or macOS.

unsupported_paths.name: Skip the wrap
unsupported_paths.detail: A process started without vantio run (Node) or without vantio-agent-sdk (Python) produces no Optics record.

unsupported_paths.name: curl, raw sockets, browser
unsupported_paths.detail: curl, raw sockets, and browser/CDP paths the wrap does not mediate produce no Optics line.

unsupported_paths.name: Fork away from the interceptor
unsupported_paths.detail: A child that leaves the wrap can egress with no local run record.

unsupported_paths.name: Oversized or streaming body
unsupported_paths.detail: Opaque streams can finish as incomplete observation (degraded), not as a full record.

unsupported_paths.name: Python prefix only
unsupported_paths.detail: vantio run python without vantio-agent-sdk on that interpreter does not intercept.

first_event: npm i -g @vantio/cli   (or run the CLI from this checkout)
Python: pip install vantio-agent-sdk, then vantio run python agent.py
No account and no paid key. If nothing was wrapped, idle is the honest result — Optics will not invent an OBSERVED row.
leave: Stop wrapping: run the agent the way you did before vantio run.
~/.vantio/runs is metadata you own (hosts, sizes, trace ids). It is not a prompt warehouse.
vantio leave --delete-local-metadata --yes   only if you want that metadata gone.
